request.initial_prompt: Hermione. Verily! You put me off with limber vows; but I, Though you would seek t' unsphere the stars with oaths, Should yet say "Sir, no going." Verily, You shall not go. A lady's verily is As potent as a lord's. Will go yet? Force me to keep you as a prisoner, Not like a guest: so you shall pay your fees When you depart, and save your thanks. How say you? My prisoner or my guest? By your dread "verily," One of them you shall be.

raw_segments.text: Hermione, Verily, You put me off with limber vows, But I, Though you would seek t' unsphere the stars with oaths, Should yet say, Sir, no going.

Verily, You shall not go. A lady's verily is As potent as a lord's. Will go yet? Force me to keep you as a prisoner, Not like a guest. So you shall pay your fees When you depart, and save your thanks.
How say you? My prisoner or my guest? By your dread, verily. One of them you shall be.
